description: This PHP source file defines the EmploymentStatusMenuConfigurator class, which implements the MenuConfigurator interface and configures menu behavior for the employment status screen within the OrangeHRM system. It uses traits for module screen helper functions and interacts with menu and screen entities to set the current screen.

classes.name: EmploymentStatusMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Configures menu settings for the employment status section by overriding the current screen to 'employmentStatus' through the module screen helper trait.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets the current screen to 'employmentStatus' by overriding it via the trait method, returning null.
